ud8.3:1.2: at one time the Fortunate One was dwelling near Sāvatthī, in Jeta’s Wood, at Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
ud8.3:1.3: Then at that time the Fortunate One was instructing, rousing, enthusing, and cheering the monks with a Dhamma talk connected with Emancipation. Those monks, after making it their goal, applying their minds,
ud8.3:1.4: considering it with all their mind, were listening to Dhamma with an attentive ear.
ud8.3:2.1: Then the Fortunate One, having understood the significance of it, on that occasion uttered this exalted utterance:
ud8.3:3.1: “There is, monks, an unborn, unbecome, unmade, unconditioned. If, monks there were not that unborn, unbecome,
ud8.3:3.2: unmade, unconditioned, you could not know an escape here from the born, become, made, and conditioned.
ud8.3:3.3: But because there is an unborn, unbecome,
ud8.3:3.4: unmade, unconditioned, therefore you do know an escape
